content.text:
Joaquin, sorry, you shouldn't have had to say it twice. Running the deletion now.

On point 1, you're right, and I explained it badly. The term isn't part of any settled convention for these processes. It's a correction I added once so that ee→tt̄ would match one particular reference calculation. MadLoop's own value is already correct, in a standard scheme. Nothing requires the extra term, and applying it to processes with several heavy quarks or b beams would mean making up a rule. So the correct and simpler choice is to leave it out. catalog_v3 stores MadLoop's value as is. That's what the 99 pools already generated (stage 2a) contain, so the remaining 68 will match them.
